releaseNotes.sw: Uchaguzi wa kiolezo cha WhatsApp unaonyesha maelezo; skana inaonyesha taarifa kamili za mgeni; ripoti: tafuta mgeni na badilisha uthibitisho (RSVP), na safu mpya ya RSVP kwenye PDF.
releaseNotes.en: WhatsApp template picker shows each template's details; scanner search shows full guest details; reports: search guests and edit RSVP, plus a new RSVP column in the PDF.
